title: Titanium Hex Bolt (ISO 4014)
alloyReason: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V (Grade 5, UNS R56400) was selected for this fastener application because its 900+ MPa tensile enables thin-wall lightweighting under cyclic loading. The alpha-beta microstructure provides 45% higher specific strength than 4140 steel, critical for weight-sensitive designs. Its 6.7 W/mK thermal conductivity simplifies thermal management. This rationale is driven by heavy hex structural bolt m12-m30 and specific design requirements.
process: CNC turning and boring for fastener geometry
surfaceTreatment: Passivation per ASTM B600 followed by hot DI water rinse 70C minimum to prevent flash rust on finished surfaces — tailored for heavy hex structural application
inspection: Visual VT ASTM E165 (heavy hex verified)
commonFailures: Surface contamination requiring acid passivation — critical for heavy hex structural performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Hex Bolt (ISO 4014) suitable for Heavy hex structural bolt M12-M30?
faq.a: Titanium Hex Bolt (ISO 4014) uses Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address fastener operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Hex Bolt (ISO 4014)?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Hex Bolt (ISO 4014) is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for heavy hex structural requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Hex Bolt (ISO 4014) require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. heavy hex structural components require Passivation per ASTM B600 followed by hot DI water rinse 70C minimum to prevent flash rust on finished surfaces — tailored for heavy hex structural application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Hex Bolt (ISO 4014) shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Hex Bolt (ISO 4014) includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet heavy hex structural specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Hex bolt / Structural bolt fastener components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
